• During the quarter we opened the 1000 th Zudio Store. We now operate a significant 
portfolio of over 1300 “large -box” fashion stores, with presence across 339 cities 
(including 3 in the UAE). In Q2FY27 we opened 10 Westside and 19 Zudio stores and 
consolidated 2 Zudio stores. As of 30th September 2026, our store portfolio included 
311 Westside, 999 Zudio (including 7 stores in the UAE) and 32 stores across other 
lifestyle concepts and we operated with a footprint of over 18.5 million sqft. across our 
fashion brands. 
• We believe given our approach with respect to merchandise sourcing, price 
architecture, distribution and disciplines around inventory provisioning, the full year 
results are more representative of the performance of the business. The gross margin 
profile of Westside and Zudio remains stable. Operating EBIT margin for Q2 FY27 
was 11.6% (10.5% for Q2FY26).

• The emerging categories, including beauty & personal care, innerwear and footwear 
contributed over 21% of our revenues. Westside online together with our proposition 
on the Tata Neu platform continues to witness traction and grow profitably. In H1FY27, 
online revenues grew by 20% and contributed to over 6% of Westside revenues.

• Star, our food and grocery business, has been witnessing encouraging consumer 
traction notwithstanding the evolving competitive landscape. Star revenues grew by 
over 20% during the quarter. The sales mix continues to favour own brands and 
increasingly delivers a viable economic profile at the store level. We added 1 new 
store during the quarter across the Star portfolio taking the overall store count to 87 
across 13 cities. We remain excited about the potential of this business.

Chairman’s Message 
Speaking on the performance, Mr. Noel N Tata, Chairman, Trent Limited said, “Our brands 
experienced solid traction during the quarter. It was encouraging to witness a more robust 
consumer sentiment despite the relatively inflationary backdrop. 
We are increasingly expanding our presence across diverse markets, including in many 
Tier 2 and Tier 3 locations. The compelling reception we are witnessing gives us the 
conviction to double down into more hinterlands. 
 
In our Star business, w e continue to apply Trent’s playbook and the contribution of our 
own brands and products is now trending at over 7 4% of revenues. Star’s recent 
performance reinforces our confidence in the business model and its growth potential. As 
we look ahead, we will continue to invest in expanding our footprint, with a focus on 
building scale and strengthening our position across markets . The food and grocery 
opportunity is significant, and the Star model is differentiated. 
As I conclude my tenure as Chairman of Trent, I could not be more delighted at the 
enormous strides the Company has made in recent years. It has been a privilege to witness 
Trent’s transformation from a fledgling entrant in the fashion sector into one of its leading 
players, distinguished by strong growth, profitability and capital efficiency. Yet, I firmly 
believe that Trent’s best days lie ahead. I look forward to seeing the Company further 
strengthen its position across the lifestyle segments in which it operates, establish a 
significant presence in the food and grocery sector, an d emerge as a meaningful exporter, 
carrying the flag of Indian brands into markets beyond our shores.” 
 
About Trent 
Trent Limited is part of the Tata Group and operates a portfolio of retail concepts. The 
primary customer propositions of Trent include Westside, one of India's leading chains of 
fashion retail stores, Zudio, a one stop destination for great fashion at great value and Star, 
which operates in the competitive food, grocery and daily needs segment. 
Westside stores have a footprint of predominantly between 20,000-30,000 sq. ft. Westside 
stocks a broad range of products ranging from apparel, footwear, accessories to cosmetics 
and perfumes to home accessories and gifts amongst others. Each Westside store presents

international shopping ambience, superior merchandise at affordable prices and excellent 
service. 
Zudio, the value fashion format destination, primarily operates with stores having a 
footprint of around 10,000-12,000 sq. ft. Zudio stores offer several product categories to 
meet the varied shopping needs of customers. These include apparel across men, women 
and kids, beauty and cosmetic products, and footwear. 
Star, the supermarket concept offers a curated assortment of products including FMCG, 
staples and a comprehensive fresh offering (vegetables, fruits, dairy & non -vegetarian 
products). Star’s product portfolio is complemented by a compelling range of exclus ive 
own branded FMCG (Fabsta, Klia, Skye, Star), general merchandise (Smartle) and apparel 
(Zudio) products at attractive prices. The Star format has increasingly evolved into a 
sustainable model with growing sales densities and repeat customers.
